subject: maths
question:
A store announces the following three schemes to sell its articles. Which of these gives the maximum discount to the buyer?

A. Two successive discounts of 20% and 24%

B. Buy 5 get 3 free

C. Buy 13 get 7 free
solution:
**Given data:**

Three schemes: A. Two successive discounts of 20% and 24%, B. Buy 5 get 3 free, C. Buy 13 get 7 free

**Concept or formula: **

Effective discount for A = 100 - [(100 - first discount) × (100 - second discount) ÷ 100]

Discount for B and C = (number of free items ÷ total items) × 100
